env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

[!exec:patch] skip 'patch unavailable'

cd m
go run .
cp stdout $WORK/go-output
cp main.go $WORK/main.orig
logos next
cp stderr $WORK/preview-stderr
! exists main.lgo
! exists next_tasks.json
cmp main.go $WORK/main.orig
grep 'review only.*loop-chain' $WORK/preview-stderr
grep 'review only.*err-return' $WORK/preview-stderr

# --fix emits a patch on stdout and must not touch a single file: sources,
# tests and the plan stay byte-identical and no .lgo file appears. Tool
# diagnostics stay off stdout, so the captured output is the patch alone.
logos next --fix
cp stdout $WORK/fix.patch
! grep '^logos next' $WORK/fix.patch
! exists main.lgo
! exists noexec_test.lgo
! exists sub/nextparity/noexec_test.lgo
! exists next_tasks.json
cmp main.go $WORK/main.orig

# Two runs over the same tree must emit the same patch bytes.
logos next --fix
cp stdout $WORK/fix2.patch
cmp $WORK/fix.patch $WORK/fix2.patch

# The patch must describe the source conversion and the required plan
# change, not just one of them.
grep '^\+\+\+ .*main\.lgo' $WORK/fix.patch
grep '^\+\+\+ .*next_tasks\.json' $WORK/fix.patch

# Applying the captured stdout must complete the conversion: every checked
# .go file becomes .lgo, including the test files, and the plan lands
# beside them. patch(1) is the non-Git consumer: it applies the emitted
# git-style encodings, including the unchanged-file rename.
exec patch --batch --fuzz=0 -p1 -i $WORK/fix.patch
! exists main.go
! exists noexec_test.go
! exists sub/nextparity/noexec_test.go
exists main.lgo
exists noexec_test.lgo
exists sub/nextparity/noexec_test.lgo
exists next_tasks.json
grep 'n, err := work\(fail\)' main.lgo
grep '\$"order \{step\(1\)\} \{flag\(\)\} \{step\(2\)\}"' main.lgo
grep 'Sprintf\("custom %t", customFlag\(true\)\)' main.lgo
grep 'Sprintf\("stringer %t", stringFlag\(true\)\)' main.lgo
grep 'Sprintf\("bytes %s", \[\]byte\("raw"\)\)' main.lgo
grep 'err-return' next_tasks.json
grep 'loop-chain' next_tasks.json
! grep '"replacement"' next_tasks.json
logos run .
cmp stdout $WORK/go-output

# A file whose only fmt use is the rewritten call keeps the call and gets
# guidance instead of an edit that would leave the import unused.
cd ../m2
go run .
cp stderr $WORK/m2-go-stderr
cp main.go $WORK/m2-main.orig
logos next
! stdout '^\+\+\+'
stderr 'review only: sprintf-interp'
! exists main.lgo
cmp main.go $WORK/m2-main.orig

# An existing plan file must come through --fix untouched, and the patch
# must carry its merge instead of replacing it wholesale.
cp ../seed/next_tasks.json next_tasks.json
cp next_tasks.json $WORK/m2-plan.orig

logos next --fix
cp stdout $WORK/m2-fix.patch
! grep '^logos next' $WORK/m2-fix.patch
! exists main.lgo
cmp main.go $WORK/m2-main.orig
cmp next_tasks.json $WORK/m2-plan.orig

logos next --fix
cp stdout $WORK/m2-fix2.patch
cmp $WORK/m2-fix.patch $WORK/m2-fix2.patch

exec patch --batch --fuzz=0 -p1 -i $WORK/m2-fix.patch
! exists main.go
exists main.lgo
exists next_tasks.json
grep 'seed task kept from a previous run' next_tasks.json
grep 'sprintf-interp' next_tasks.json
grep 'fmt\.Sprintf' main.lgo
logos build ./...
logos test ./...

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/nextparity

go 1.27
-- m/main.go --
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"logos/rt"
)

var failure = errors.New("sample failure")
var recorded error
var order int

func work(fail bool) (int, error) {
	order = order*10 + 9
	if fail {
		return 27, failure
	}
	return 42, nil
}

const zero = 0x0

func typedZero(fail bool) (int, error) {
	n, err := work(fail)
	if err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}
	return n, nil
}

func boxed(fail bool) (any, error) {
	n, err := work(fail)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return n, nil
}

func visibleAssignment() error {
	_, recorded = work(true)
	if recorded != nil {
		return recorded
	}
	return nil
}

func mapped(xs []int) []int {
	var ys []int
	for _, x := range xs {
		ys = append(ys, x*2)
	}
	return ys
}

func step(n int) int {
	order = order*10 + n
	return order
}

func flag() bool {
	return step(3) == 13
}

type customFlag bool

func (customFlag) Format(s fmt.State, verb rune) {
	if _, err := fmt.Fprint(s, "custom"); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

type stringFlag bool

func (stringFlag) String() string { return "stringer" }

func report(value any, err error) {
	fmt.Printf("%T:%v %t\n", value, value, err == failure)
}

func main() {
	for _, fail := range []bool{false, true} {
		report(typedZero(fail))
		report(boxed(fail))
	}
	fmt.Println(visibleAssignment() == failure, recorded == failure)
	fmt.Println("trace sites:", len(rt.ErrorTrace()))
	for _, values := range [][]int{nil, {}, {1}, {1, 2, 3}, {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}} {
		mappedValues := mapped(values)
		fmt.Println(mappedValues, mappedValues == nil, cap(mappedValues))
	}
	order = 0
	fmt.Println(fmt.Sprintf("order %d %t %d", step(1), flag(), step(2)), order)
	fmt.Println(fmt.Sprintf("custom %t", customFlag(true)))
	fmt.Println(fmt.Sprintf("stringer %t", stringFlag(true)))
	fmt.Println(fmt.Sprintf("bytes %s", []byte("raw")))
}
-- m/noexec_test.go --
package main

import "testing"

func TestNextMustNotRunProjectTests(t *testing.T) {
	t.Fatal("next executed a project test")
}
-- m/sub/nextparity/noexec_test.go --
package nextparity

import "testing"

func TestNextMustNotRunSubpackageTests(t *testing.T) {
	t.Fatal("next executed another package's tests")
}

-- m2/go.mod --
module example.com/nextlastuse

go 1.27

-- m2/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func flag() bool { return true }

func label() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%t", flag())
}

func main() {
	println(label())
}

    {
      "id": "seed-001",
      "category": "ai-patch",
      "file": "main.lgo",
      "span": {
        "start_line": 3,
        "end_line": 4
      },
      "rule": "err-return",
      "function_signature": "label()",
      "ai_instruction": "seed task kept from a previous run",
      "verification_cmd": "logos build ./..."
    }
  ]
}
